summary.name: Cutaway / Exploded 3D Illustration is in the Digital and 3D Aesthetics category. Provenance is extracted, from a completed Skillry posted-text review added 2026-10-13. The source-reference post is recorded, and the prompt is not partial.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: genuine 3D component geometry, section views and exploded assemblies explain internal structure. Parts separate along meaningful axes, labels stay attached through camera motion, and assembly orientation is preserved. Internal flow paths use semantic colors and reassemble precisely.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: explaining the internal structure of physical components, such as a procedural lens assembly with an internal light path. Inferred: technical explainers, mechanism breakdowns and educational scenes that need labeled internal flow. Subject, audience and scene choices are task inputs, so they are unspecified here.
summary.limitations: Explicit: a flat SVG depth illusion is rejected because genuine 3D geometry is required. Preview geometry is procedural, so a simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production or validated physics. Stateful simulations must be prepared or cached first. The background hex is an authored default, and the source poster was not inspected.
summary.palette: Status: style-compatible suggestion for new artwork when no approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #101820 for the scene field only; foreground #EFF4F7 for text; steel #8196A5 for housing metal; glass_cyan #61D4DC for lens tint; flow_blue #628BF4 and flow_warm #EF9F5C for internal flow. Gradients are disabled, so use discrete tokens. Task-approved colors override these. Object, material and emission colors must not replace the background. Normal text targets 4.5:1 contrast, checked on composited pixels. Neutral staging must stay distinct from black barrels, red tissue, blue vessels and gold materials.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: GSAP owns part offsets along the optical axis and a calm camera arc. The example 3-second preview runs assembled at 0–0.5s, axial separation and cutaway at 0.5–1.5s, a held labeled path at 1.5–2.4s, and precise reassembly by 3s. Leader lines draw with DrawSVGPlugin, and labels reproject from part anchors on every seek. Arrowheads and anchor dots appear only after their stroke arrives. Label text stays hidden until its caption backing exists. Sharp cuts and reading holds are kept deliberately. HTML interaction is unspecified.
summary.audio: Unspecified as a requirement. Suggested dimensions are background music mood and tempo, voiceover language and pace, whether sung vocals help or distract, and sound effects or ambience for key actions. Mechanism sound fits only meaningful visible action. Honor supplied audio, since catalog previews are silent. Do not default to instrumental music or invent audio assets; state assumptions instead.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicit: the style requires no mandatory external assets. glTF parts are used only if authorized assets are supplied. Local fonts and assets must load before rendering. The motion-reference candidate list is empty, and no reference is required. Exact copy, duration, aspect ratio, resolution, frame rate and output directory are task inputs, so they are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Compatibility suggestions, not limits. style-097 supports causal labels and internal flow explanation. style-093 supports concise technical headings. Keep style-127 dominant and use supporting styles for narrative roles only, without importing their palettes. Avoid competing full-frame treatments and invented measurements. Inferred for HTML: keep the same hierarchy and offer reduced-motion controls where interaction is supported.
summary.productionApproach: Style renderer: Three.js with PBR materials and SVG overlays owns geometry, materials, lighting and labels. Cutaways use a clipping plane with stencil caps or explicit cut-face geometry, so no faces appear hollow. Motion engine: GSAP with DrawSVGPlugin, with one owner per animated property. Render pipeline: HyperFrames by default; Remotion only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. Verify forward, backward and direct seeks, decoded frames, contrast and audio sync.
